meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复各类运行时故障，从崩溃到内存泄漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常遭遇崩溃、泄漏或莫名失败却难以定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix any runtime failure, from crashes to memory leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face crashes, leaks, or unexplained failures and can't find the root cause.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按假设驱动的流程查运行时问题:先同时提出至少 3 个假设并并行排查,连续两轮失败后用 Oracle 换角度;确认根因后先写失败测试,再做最小修改,最后实际运行系统验证,并清理调试痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要调试崩溃、卡死、静默失败等运行时问题,或说出 “debug this”、“attach a debugger”、“reverse engineer” 等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我查为什么这个接口返回 200 但内容是空的
say.note: Claude 会先复现,再按假设驱动流程定位根因。

say.text: 这个测试只在 CI 上偶发失败,帮我定位根因
say.note: 会进入 flaky triage 的排查流程。

say.text: 用 gdb 附加到崩溃的进程,找出崩溃原因
say.note: 会先读取对应运行时的参考文档再操作。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a hypothesis-driven debugger: ≥3 hypotheses in parallel; after 2 failed rounds, Oracles from new angles; confirm root cause, failing-test first, minimal fix, QA by real use, then scrub artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to debug real runtime problems in any language or binary — crashes, hangs, silent failures, etc. — or use trigger phrases like 'debug this', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer'.

say_en.text: Why does this API return 200 but an empty body?
say_en.note: It reproduces first, then runs the loop.

say_en.text: This test only fails intermittently in CI — find the root cause.
Attach gdb to the crashing process and find the cause.
say_en.note: Reads the matching runtime reference first.
